description: This file defines the IBasketService interface, which includes method signatures for basket-related operations such as transferring, adding items, setting quantities, and deleting a basket in an e-commerce application.

classes.name: IBasketService
classes.description: An interface outlining basket operations related to customer shopping baskets in the e-commerce application.

methods.name: TransferBasketAsync
methods.description: Transfers basket contents from an anonymous to a registered user.

methods.name: AddItemToBasket
methods.description: Adds a specified item to the user's basket with given quantity and price.

methods.name: SetQuantities
methods.description: Sets multiple item quantities in a basket based on provided dictionary.
